reviews.comment: Dr. Berkolaiko is a wonderful professor. He doesn't take himself too seriously but it is clear that he has a deep love and understanding of mathematics. He has an old-school teaching style and lectures on the whiteboard and isn't too tech-savvy. The cutoff for an A is an 85 and he is very forgiving in his grading of tests and quizzes. Funny guy too

He's a good teacher, its just that the subject matter makes it a very hard class to understand. He explains concepts well and is willing to go over topics multiple times to ensure you understand. His quizzes are basically from the HW, and his tests are straightforward if you spent enough time reviewing the material. Getting an A is hard but doable
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Berkolaiko is a fantastic prof and a genuinely great guy. His lectures were organized and he explained the material clearly. The midterm and final make up 80% of your grade, but he is a fair grader and if you do the HW they really are not difficult. Also, knowing some basic probability like STAT211 is important. Would highly recommend him.

Theory of PDEs is a very difficult subject, but Dr. Berkolaiko is doing his best to make his students understand. This class is very HW heavy, and homeworks are difficult. If you don't understand something, go to his office hours and read the book. He is very helpful during his office hours. Dr. Berkolaiko is a great prof and a very nice guy.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Dr. Berkolaiko was one of the best math professors I have ever taken. His homework policy is a weekly assignment that is either taken up or quizzed on based on a coin flip. The cutoff for an A is an 85. The honors section has to complete an individual project at the end of the semester. Overall he was a great lecturer and I would recommend him!
Great professor, really knows what he is talking about in lecture and does a great job of conveying it to his students. Would highly recommend.

Avoid this class unless you have already taken MATH325, or else it is REALLY HARD. It  might still be. DO NOT LOOK AT THE SOLUTIONS FOR THE HOMEWORK. JUST DON'T. There are 2 exams worth 90% of the final grade, but if you study the past exams and notes they're not too bad and he does curve. Homework recommended, get whatever credit you can.

Overall good professor but his test are way to difficult. I had a very good understanding of the material as i took Diff Eq before and made an A. However his test are very very tricky and i ended up with a C in the class. Avoid this professor!
